name: AgentX-Benchmark
description: AgentX-Benchmark evaluates the capability of autonomous agents to perform multi-step, goal-directed tasks across diverse simulated environments and scenarios. It measures agents' planning, reasoning, and execution skills by providing structured tasks that require long-horizon decision making and environment interaction. The benchmark includes a variety of task types and records task success, step efficiency, and other operational metrics to assess agentic competence.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (and related operational metrics / composite score)
general_score_metric: task success rate / composite success metric
reputation: An emerging benchmark for evaluating agentic and planning capabilities, with growing interest from the agent/robotics research community.
